story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: From strategic vision to industrial reality
story.p1: SILVIET was founded with a clear purpose: to address the growing demand for quality precipitated silica in Southeast Asia while building sustainable local industrial capacity.
story.p2: Vietnam's strategic location, robust logistics infrastructure, and access to raw materials make it an ideal hub for silica production and distribution. We recognized this opportunity and committed to a methodical, phased approach to development.
story.p3: Our approach prioritizes long-term value over short-term gains. We believe in building genuine partnerships with our clients, understanding their needs, and growing together as the industry evolves.

roadmap.title: Development Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: A phased approach to sustainable growth

phase1.name: Phase 1: Foundation (0-18 months)
phase1.title: Commercial & Logistics Development
phase1.description: Establishing commercial operations, building logistics networks, developing client relationships, and accumulating market data. Focus on becoming a reliable trading and sourcing partner.

phase2.name: Phase 2: Development (18-36 months)
phase2.title: Pilot Production & Technology
phase2.description: Initiating pilot production, testing product formulations, developing technical expertise, and establishing quality control systems. Building partnerships with technology providers.

phase3.name: Phase 3 — Production Expansion (Years 3–6)
phase3.title: Enhancing Capacity and Product Diversification
phase3.description: Develop silica production capacity in Vietnam, reduce dependence on imports, expand product portfolio, and serve broader industrial applications.

phase4.name: Phase 4 — Regional Industrial Platform
phase4.title: Integrated Chemical and Materials Supply Network
phase4.description: Expand production capacity, scale trading & logistics, build a comprehensive supply platform, and serve domestic & global markets.

capabilities.title: Export & Supply Chain Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: How we maintain standard-compliant delivery for international partners.

cap.d1: Heavy-duty multi-layer paper bags, jumbo bags (FIBC), and customized palletized packaging optimized for sea freight.
cap.d2: Comprehensive provision of Certificate of Analysis (COA), Technical Data Sheets (TDS), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and custom clearance documents.
cap.d3: Supporting standardized global trade terms including FOB, CFR, CIF, and door-to-door domestic delivery parameters.
cap.d4: Strategic alliances with world-class shipping lines and local freight forwarders to minimize delays and optimize transit costs.
